content.content: When invoked as `deccy remove <id>` naming a node that an evaluation evaluates among others, the deccy CLI shall refuse the invocation, naming the evaluation.
content.rationale: Removal takes the node's own gates with it (myprwuxt), but a gate whose coverage reaches past the named node still covers the others it evaluates, so removing the node would strand coverage the removal was not asked to touch; refusing, and naming the gate, keeps the removal's reach the named node's own.
